messages:
anna: quick thread  we keep seeing cross-owner evict races on prefix handoff. want to discuss a refactor boundary: separate "eviction decision" from "handoff commitment" so decisions are cheap and idempotent.
tom: sounds good. current problem is decisions depend on transient metrics and then handoff can fail, leaving two nodes thinking they own.
priya: two parts: 1) make score computation pure (no side-effects) and log inputs, 2) make handoff an explicit commit with epoch bumping. If commit fails, we retry but we need a stable abort path.
lee: implementation note: use lease_epoch as single source of truth. decision emits (prefix, decision, score, epoch_seen, tiebreak_seq). commit path does CAS against epoch. if CAS fails, do read-and-merge.
anna: spelling note: it's anna not annan :)
priya: also consider evict-by-deadline vs score. deadline-driven evicts need to be logged as "deadline" reasons and have higher priority in commit pipeline to reduce oscillation.
tom: what about shared cache mode? multiple tenants on same slab can cause eviction churn that looks like cross-owner race but is just backpressure. propose adding per-slab admission credits and using a soft-evict token to defer full handoff.
lee: nice idea. soft-evict token = mark as candidate and only migrate real residency when credits available. avoids double-apply and reduces race window. track token with epoch so it's safe to be idempotent.
priya: testing: we need a chaos test that simulates interleaved commit failures + concurrent prefills. also add a determinism harness for tie-breakers.
anna: compliance: redact tenant id in logs (hash+HMAC). private deployments can disable hmac.
tom: next steps: priya will draft API change (separate decision vs commit), lee will prototype soft-evict token, anna will add small chaos test, i'll add metrics for token churn.
lee: ops-bot: create ticket?
devops-bot: created ENG-1251 prefix-evict-decision-commit-split, assignees priya, lee, anna, tom.
anna: cool. aim for prototype in 2w. if anyone thinks coupling decision+commit helps latency, call it out now. otherwise i'll start the RFC sketch.
